mapper.insert:
INSERT IGNORE INTO contact_friend_task_recipient (tenant_id, task_id, task_account_id, contact_phone, contact_jid, contact_named, send_status, attempt_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES
(#{row.tenantId}, #{row.taskId}, #{row.taskAccountId}, #{row.contactPhone}, #{row.contactJid}, #{row.contactNamed}, 'PENDING', 0, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT r.task_account_id FROM contact_friend_task_recipient r JOIN contact_friend_task_account a ON a.id = r.task_account_id WHERE r.task_id = #{taskId} AND r.send_status = 'PENDING' AND a.state IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contact_friend_task_recipient active WHERE active.task_account_id = r.task_account_id AND active.send_status = 'SENDING') GROUP BY r.task_account_id ORDER BY r.task_account_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE contact_friend_task_recipient SET send_status = 'SENDING', round_no = #{roundNo}, command_id = #{commandId}, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, last_attempt_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND send_status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE contact_friend_task_recipient SET send_status = 'SUCCESS', protocol_message_id = #{protocolMessageId}, error_code = NULL, error_desc = NULL, first_sent_at = COALESCE(first_sent_at, #{resultAt}), updated_at = #{resultAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND send_status IN ('SENDING', 'UNKNOWN')
UPDATE contact_friend_task_recipient SET send_status = 'FAILED', error_code = #{errorCode}, error_desc = #{errorDesc}, updated_at = #{resultAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND send_status = 'SENDING'

UPDATE contact_friend_task_recipient SET send_status = 'PENDING', command_id = NULL, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_desc = #{errorDesc}, updated_at = #{resultAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND send_status = 'SENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contact_friend_task_recipient WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND send_status IN ('PENDING', 'SENDING')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contact_friend_task_recipient WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND send_status = 'SENDING'
SELECT FROM contact_friend_task_recipient WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM contact_friend_task_recipient WHERE command_id = #{commandId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE contact_friend_task_recipient SET send_status = 'UNKNOWN', protocol_message_id = COALESCE(#{protocolMessageId}, protocol_message_id), error_code = #{errorCode}, error_desc = #{errorDesc}, updated_at = #{resultAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND send_status = 'SENDING'

UPDATE contact_friend_task_recipient SET protocol_message_id = #{messageId}, delivered_at = COALESCE(delivered_at, #{resultAt}), read_at = CASE WHEN #{read} THEN COALESCE(read_at, #{resultAt}) ELSE read_at END, updated_at = GREATEST(updated_at, #{resultAt}) WHERE id = #{id} AND send_status IN ('SENDING', 'UNKNOWN', 'SUCCESS') AND (protocol_message_id IS NULL OR protocol_message_id = #{messageId})

UPDATE contact_friend_task_recipient SET send_status = 'SKIPPED', error_code = 'ACCOUNT_STOPPED', error_desc = #{reason}, updated_at = #{resultAt} WHERE task_account_id = #{taskAccountId} AND send_status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contact_friend_task_recipient WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND task_account_id = #{taskAccountId}
